title: NTUeats
subtitle: Mobile App Design & Development
contributions: Designed the app's interface, typography, and colors in Figma, and created hand-drawn assets in Procreate.
Built the interface from wireframes and low-fidelity prototypes using React Native and Expo, utilizing React hooks for state management and side effects.
Planned the data structure with an ER diagram and integrated Firebase Firestore, Cloud Storage, and Gemini AI to support cloud content and image uploads and retrieval.

showcasePages.name: Login & Sign Up
showcasePages.description: Users can log in or create an account, with Clerk handling email validation and checking that passwords meet the required criteria during sign-up.

showcasePages.name: Home
showcasePages.description: Users can have a quick look at EatWHAT (list of stalls) and CookWHAT (list of recipes), alongside notifications for new likes and comments on their posts. Tapping a notification takes them straight to the relevant post.

showcasePages.name: Food Randomizer
showcasePages.description: For users who can't decide what to eat, the randomizer suggests a dish or stall with a playful animation. It sits at the bottom of the home page.

showcasePages.name: EatWHAT / CookWHAT
showcasePages.description: Users can browse stalls and recipes, search for something specific, filter by type, or sort by popularity and recency.

showcasePages.name: Navigation
showcasePages.description: Users can swipe right or tap the menu icon to open the navigation panel and move easily between pages.

showcasePages.name: Stall Details
showcasePages.description: Inspired by Google Reviews, this page brings together stall reviews, menus, and photos uploaded by users. Reviews can be sorted, while pop-up menus and expandable images make the details easier to explore.

showcasePages.name: Recipes
showcasePages.description: Users can see the recipe overview, cooking steps, and comments, making it easy to follow along and see what others have shared.

showcasePages.name: Upload a Recipe
showcasePages.description: This page shows the form layout used throughout the app. Users can add extra input fields as needed and organize their recipe instructions into numbered steps.

showcasePages.name: Profile
showcasePages.description: Users can revisit saved and liked items, manage their comments and uploaded recipes, and update their dietary preferences and profile details.

showcasePages.name: Report
showcasePages.description: Users can flag issues such as closed stalls or inappropriate comments, helping keep the app's content up to date. Gemini AI sorts reports by category and issue type to make them easier for administrators to review.

showcasePages.name: Admin
showcasePages.description: The admin panel lets administrators add and edit stalls and review community reports. It was still a work in progress, with more tools planned.
